description: Shows which Buzz Dealer AI account this connection uses: the account name, its plan, the available balance in US dollars and, for a connection limited to some brands, their names. Use this when the person has more than one account and asks which one is linked. Do not use for the budget frame or orders. Side effects: none; read only.
name: get_linked_account

brands.description: For a connection limited to some brands, their names; null when it sees every brand

title: Which account is linked
